705190201.text: Bernhard, we've got all the funds you need!

705190202.text: Already? Wow, you sure work fast!

705190203.text: Everything's in place, we just need to open shop now.

705190204.text: Alright, our suppliers are ready and waiting — just give me a moment.

705190205.text: Bernhard pays the suppliers with Fairbrew Jellies, and before long the shop is complete.

705190206.text: What do you think? Not bad, huh? Of course, if you're in a creative mood at any point, feel free to redecorate the place however you want.

705190207.text: It's great! Really looks the part!

705190208.text: The shop definitely needs a name though! Hmm, how about... "Favonian Goodies"?

705190210.text: ...Paimon will take that as a compliment! Okay, Bernhard, so what do you need us to do next?

705190213.text: Gathering the funds was a monumental task. It must have been very demanding. So don't worry about all the other menial things that need doing — I'll handle those.

705190214.text: You both have more experience than me. It'd be great if you could figure out the more managerial-level things like our sales strategy, SOPs, USPs, QC principles, KPIs...

705190215.text: I've gotta be honest — I hear other store owners using these terms, but I can't say I really know what they mean. I just know they're important... which means they're probably best dealt with by you.

705190216.text: So in other words, we'll be the shop owners who make the big business decisions, and you'll be the shop assistant doing all the actual day-to-day work?

705190217.text: Yep, my strength is in execution. Your shop, your rules! I am but a tool to be used however you see fit!

705190219.text: Umm... That sounds a little extreme. This is for charity, remember? We're not some cutthroat business executives...

705190220.text: Alright, why don't you go ahead and take a tight five, Bernhard? The two of us need to touch base on strategy.

705190221.text: You and Paimon analyze the product offering and hash out some core strategic action points...

705190222.text: Okay, we have a clear corporate mission statement: Our goal is to become the best darn snack shop in the whole festival market!

705190223.text: Now, let's all prepare to give 110% as we receive our first customers...

705190226.text: Mona and Fischl! You came to check out the market, huh?

705190227.text: Hm! One was wise to follow one's intuition, and ask Lady Megistus to join the Prinzessin on a tour of this folk festival...

705190228.text: Extraordinary events may yet unfold even on this unexceptional autumn day... Splendid, most splendid!

705190229.text: Mein Fräulein is battling hard to suppress the euphoria in her voice. Seeing you here has put her in the most wonderful mood...

705190230.text: O—Oz! Spare us your gratuitous embellishments!

705190231.text: Hehehe, maybe you should leave me to do the explaining.

705190232.text: Not long ago, Her Highness had a very nice dream, and took it as an sign that something good was about to happen. Naturally, Her Highness' first thought was to come to me for some astrological guidance on the matter.

705190233.text: She also noticed that the Weinlesefest was in full flow, and asked if I was interested in checking it out with her.

705190234.text: I, of course, agreed. I can take advantage of the festival-period discounts to purchase some bulk supplies for my present column-writing spree.

705190235.text: I must admit, without Her Highness' reminder, the Weinlesefest may well have completely passed me by...

705190236.text: Lady Megistus, might Her Highness remind you that the dream of which you speak occurred no less than nine days ago...

705190237.text: And that only after awaiting Lady Megistus's return letter in vain for all this time did one have no recourse but to rap most furiously upon the door to thy abode...

705190238.text: Wait... it's been nine days already? NINE DAYS!? Where did the time go!

705190239.text: In light of the great importance this manuscript has to you, Lady Megistus, one shall not hold thy inattentiveness to the passage of time against thee.

705190240.text: But I would implore you, Lady Megistus, to be attentive at least to the nigh-overflowing mailbox outside your door. There appear to be many others whose letters go unanswered.

705190241.text: Wow, Mona... you were so immersed in your research that you forgot all about the time, stopped checking your mail, and almost missed out on a huge festival.

705190212.text: Hey! A little feedback on the name, please? A nod of the head, perhaps!?

705190301.text: Renowned Honorary Knight and Paimon, Teyvat's premier guide, please help me organize a charity event!

705190302.text: You help Bernhard set the charity stall up.

705190303.text: Thank you both. Now let's open for business!
